evidence.source_statement: For Tarium machine-readable ontology and gallery schemas, validate required fields, stable IDs, type constraints and cross-references automatically against representative valid and invalid public fixtures when such structured schemas are declared.
source_conditions: This published requirement is applicable only to the expressly authorized independent Tarium project and its declared source or public contract.

interpretation.situation_scope: Situations are not exhaustive triggers and do not narrow normative applicability.
